changelog:
🚀 JARVIS AI v1.8.6 Mega Update!

✨ KYA NAYA ADD HUA (NEW FEATURES):
• 🧠 Smart Long-Term Memory: JARVIS ab aapki car parking, favorite cheezein aur personal baatein hamesha yaad rakhta hai aur bina delay turant batata hai.
• 🌙 One-Shot Smart Routines:
  - 'Good Night Jarvis': Brightness 10%, Volume 20%, Silent/DND mode, Wi-Fi off aur subah ka alarm verify karega.
  - 'Focus Mode': Notifications mute, 45-min Pomodoro timer aur lo-fi music start karega.
• 🎯 Smart Pronoun Tracker: 'Usko call karo' ya 'Message bhejo' bolne par bina baar-baar 'Who?' puche last contact ko call/message karega.
• 🎙️ Marvel MCU Persona: Tony Stark ke JARVIS jaisa British wit, loyalty aur respectful humor.

🛠️ KYA FIX HUA (BUG FIXES):
• ⚡ Fast Standby Wake: Background se aane par 5 second ka gap khatam, ab turant 1 sec me greet karega.
• 🔄 Smooth Navigation: App me pages change karne par voice connection kabhi break nahi hoga.
• 🔊 Mic Unblock: Bolte hi mic turant unblock ho jata hai, zero word cutting.
• 🛡️ Zero Hallucinations: Memory se exact saved details hi batayega, random gaane guess nahi karega.
